svg.text: Hex layouts scored on every published facet
Darker = better within each column (best to worst among these 7 layouts). Numbers are the scores. All 7 layouts are Pareto-optimal on these 14 columns: none is beaten on every one.
Against NYU, every other layout is better on 10 to 13 of the 14 columns.
